critical_code_review_comments: coaching_routes.py toggle_calendar_entry_coach uses `done: bool` as a bare query param — FastAPI will 422 if omitted rather than defaulting; consider `done: bool = True` or explicit Query(...) for clearer contract. Currently the frontend always sends it so this is fine, but a nice-to-have.

The customer-side PATCH /my/calendar/{entry_id} in coaching_routes.py does NOT set done_at (only done). The new coach PATCH sets done_at. If done_at is meant to be the canonical 'when marked done' timestamp for reporting/analytics, the customer endpoint should also set it for parity. Minor consistency issue.

Both PATCH endpoints allow done_at to be cleared to null when done=false. If historical tracking of 'was ever done' is desirable, consider preserving done_at on false→true→false cycles or storing a separate log. Nice-to-have.

Minor React warning observed in console: `<span>` cannot be a child of `<option>` — originates from an editor-instrumentation wrapper (data-ve-dynamic attribute on <option>) around the week-select options, not from CoachClientDetail's own JSX. Cosmetic; ignore unless the wrapper is under project control.
